concerns.text: plan.md T018 specifies an integration test `tests/test_pipeline.py` that runs the full pilot end-to-end (N=100, all 6 depths), but no task in tasks.md creates this test file. T010 only re-runs the documented quickstart workflow and runs `pytest code/tests/` — it never authors `test_pipeline.py`. Either add a task producing this integration test or explicitly supersede plan T018 in the 'Corrections from prior rounds' section (as was done for the state-manager tasks), so the plan element is not silently orphaned.
